title.narrative: MeCAHT. Preventing Human Trafficking and Smuggling of Human Beings in Nigeria. 2023-2028.

description.narrative:
The overall obejctive is to create awareness campaigns targeting groups that are at risk of becoming or that have been victims of human trafficking. The engagement also supports MeCAHT’s collaboration with Nigerian authorities and their work to combat human trafficking. The obejctive is reached through the following actions:
1. Increasing public awareness and access to rescue support – sensitizing 40,000 vulnerable individuals, training 180 community members put information about assistance in the hands of 700 returned victims and survivors of trafficking.
2. Economic impact through training and business opportunities – targeting 600 returnees/survivors to increase their hire ability and life skills and 100 returnees/survivors for educational advancement.
3. Changing the landscape of knowledge-sharing through High Level Advocacy Engagement and Capacity Building – knowledge-sharing with 50 industry experts across counter human trafficking organizations, government, and law enforcement and capacity building of MeCAHT staff.
